 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Serbisyopubliko Serbisyo Publiko WALANG PASOK: Class suspensions for Monday, October 26, 2026 
 By GMA News Published October 25, 2026 2:14pm 
 Updated October 26, 2026 12:58pm + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Classes for Monday, October 26, 2026, have been suspended in some schools and areas due to the rising reports of illnesses among students and preparations for government events.
 Below are the class suspensions for Monday, October 26, 2026:
 Philippine Science High School-Main Campus : All classes suspended on Monday, October 26, and Tuesday, October 27. Classes to shift to online learning setup on October 28 to 29 (Wednesday and Thursday)
.
 Cotabato City : Face-to-face classes at all levels are prohibited from October 26 to 31; classes should be conducted through asynchronous learning for this period; this is in preparation for the inaugural session of the 1st Bangsamoro Regular Parliament.
 Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu 
 Public and private elementary and high schools in the barangays Ibo, Buaya, Mactan, and P. Engaño, as well as the following private schools and colleges, from October 26 to 30, 2026:
 Private Schools
 Sto. Niño International School
 EMD Carmelite School Foundation
 Jose Alwins Learning School
 B Cebu Dream Foundation, Inc.
 Cebu International Language TVI Center
